title: Visitors appear when Anne's chosen groups come to the cabin

tellings.quote: And when she would get these groups up at the cabin, the visitors would show up.

plain: Whitley Strieber, an author who says he has met beings he calls "the visitors", talks about his cabin in upstate New York in the late 1980s and 1990s. He says that when Anne Strieber brought groups of people she had chosen up to the cabin, the visitors would show up. If true, it would mean these beings appeared on a kind of cue, around certain people, and more than once.
